div.br:
• Each layer only uses the one right below it.
• JPA entities never leave the API: controllers answer with DTOs.
• No business logic in the controllers.
• No scattered try/catch: services throw SierapException subclasses and exception translates them.
• No hard-coded business values (ADR-010).
• Dashed border: planned, not built yet.
